name: wq
description: Multivariate regression data set from: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs10994-016-5546-z : The Water Quality dataset (Dzeroski et al. 2000) has 14 target attributes that refer to the relative representation of plant and animal species in Slovenian rivers and 16 input attributes that refer to physical and chemical water quality parameters.
